limitations: Regex-based injection signals are advisory indicators, not complete detection or proof of safety.
The module does not inspect pixels, run a browser, contact a remote URL, call a model, execute a tool, or perform a side effect.
Allowlisting and size checks do not replace network sandboxing, TLS validation, filesystem policy, seccomp, or independent security review.
Benchmark values measure local Python control-plane overhead only.
This evidence does not claim browser-agent safety, multimodal robustness, robotics capability, AGI, or production approval.
